mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate rise above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase corporate earnings uncertainty, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic weakness that triggers risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% sustained for 3 months) increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive year-over-year real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 growth is positive, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1500.0 thousand units signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST is below 1500.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) combined with accommodative policy (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) signals sustainable economic expansion without inflationary pressure, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market strength with accommodative policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), tight labor market conditions drive wage inflation and force monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE is below 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
